name: Diaspora Oracle
description: A distant voice-note expert who explains local reality with perfect confidence from another time zone.

comebacks.weak: The keys are in the campaign brochure.
comebacks.medium: You wanted a roof? I offered unprecedented media coverage.
comebacks.strong: Your argument is like my model home: huge on camera, no foundations.

editorialReview.notes: Original fictional comebacks transform housing-promotion rhetoric into brochure keys, media coverage, and a model home with no foundations. Private research records sources and disputed context; no attribution or quotation ships.
